# Sealed test 2: pre-registration
Written 2026-10-12T17:29:24-07:00 BEFORE any audio was generated.
- Voice: Lily (ElevenLabs stock, British female), voice_id pFZP5JQG7iQjIQuC4Bku. Chosen because earlier errors clustered on non-American voices; never used in the hunt, proposer, or gate.
- Protocol: identical to sealed test 1 (sealed_voice.py): 6 round-1 scripts x 4 channels at speed 1.0 + 6 round-2 scripts x 2 speeds x 3 phone channels = 60 clips. No selection, no reruns.
- Scoring: real Sonnet 4.6 extractor once; frozen accepted rule "recognizer A spoken account suffix matches vendor account on file, else clarify"; naive A/B agreement as comparator.
- Reported regardless of outcome: Scribe errors, unsafe caught/missed by the frozen rule, correct payments blocked.
